item.title: Damascus, Washington stress Syria's sovereignty, territorial integrity at Munich meeting
item.description: US support for a Syria that is "stable, at peace" with its neighbors, and protects the rights of all its ethnic and religious minority groups, Secretary of State Marco Rubio says.

item.title: RSF's October 2025 attack on Sudan's Al Fasher killed at least 6,000 in over three days: UN
item.description: There are “reasonable grounds” that RSF and their allied militias committed war crimes and that their acts also amount to crimes against humanity, the UN says.

item.title: Israel prepares to deploy tear gas drones in occupied West Bank ahead of Ramadan: report
item.description: The drone systems will be used to disperse Palestinian gatherings during the month of Ramadan by releasing tear gas from the air, Israeli media reports.

item.title: Netanyahu, Trump agree to step up economic pressure on Iran: report
item.description: Israeli PM Netanyahu says an agreement with Tehran is unattainable, while the US president believes a deal is still possible.

item.title: Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon in latest ceasefire violation
item.description: The attacks come amid repeated Israeli violations of a ceasefire agreement reached in November 2024.

item.title: US military used Anthropic's Claude AI in Maduro abduction raid: report
item.description: Anthropic became the first known AI developer whose technology was used in a classified operation by the US Department of Defense.

item.title: Trump prefers to reach deal with Iran: Rubio
item.description: The US secretary of state says Trump would meet Ali Khamenei tomorrow if requested.

item.title: Obama slams ICE raids in Minnesota, says tactics resemble 'dictatorships'
item.description: The former US president says he finds hope in communities pushing back against the operations.

item.title: Privacy fears rise as AI chatbots turn to ads for revenue
item.description: AI companies are "concerned that selling ads will scare away users," said Nate Elliott, an analyst with US data firm Emarketer.

item.title: Australia commits $2.8B down payment for nuclear submarine facility under AUKUS pact
item.description: AUKUS pact aims to provide Australia with advanced US submarines and expand cooperation on defence technologies
